items.source: Uses of RollingPolicySystemProperty in org.springframework.boot.logging.logback
Support for the Logback logging library.

Logback rolling policy system properties that can later be used by log configuration
files.
items.translation: Logback 滚动策略系统属性，稍后可在日志配置文件中使用。
